in_marathi.name: Surbhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Surbhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Surbhi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Susrusha’ which means ‘sweet smelling’ or ‘golden’. In Hindu mythology, Surbhi is also the name of a celestial apsara or a goddess, who is known for her beauty and grace.
